decided: When a project signs off once per program and the architect session cannot save the program's brief, the session says so in one line, asks the user nothing, and does not report the program as done in that session. With the setting off, the failure is written only into the session's own record.
alternatives: ask the user to sign the latest copy saved earlier
why: An earlier copy may not be the program's current text, so a signature over it would cover work the user has not seen; the archive treats a failed save of a change's brief the same way.

relies_on.title: The archive holds for a per-change sign-off
